specReadingConvention: Where the taxonomy's spec half is missing and no parser-band adjudication covers the input, the cell is counted AGAINST the candidate (MIS_ACCEPT / FALSE_REJECT_IN_SHAPE) and flagged specUndecided. shape.rule: an input naming a function head the ORACLE accepts nowhere in the corpus is OUTSIDE the declared shape (COVERAGE_NARROWING); everything else is INSIDE, whether or not the candidate's R_disp carries a row for it
